calculation_lineage.formula: GO available = general_revenue - operating_costs_excluding_debt_service_and_pension - pension_paid; illustrative coverage = available / direct_debt_service
net pledge available = gross_pledged_revenue - operating_costs - prior_payments; gross pledge available = gross_pledged_revenue - prior_payments; reserve excluded from recurring coverage
direct debt service = supplied direct principal + supplied direct interest; overlapping and contingent exposures shown separately; no automatic legal allocation
unfunded capital = max(0, capital_needs - committed_capital_funding); pension shortfall = max(0, required_contribution-paid_contribution)
